cpu-d3-standard.cost_assumptions: Public PAYG list price, taxes and account discounts excluded. The preemptible CPU ceiling conservatively uses the normal CPU/RAM rate because the public table has no separate non-GPU preemptible row. Empty Object Storage costs zero; the estimate models its full configured quota as an upper bound.

local_nvme.notes: Not requested: no local-NVMe support has been verified for this allowed project/platform combination.
